_comment: Your alert rules. A rule fires when a NEWLY OPEN slot matches it. Edit freely — no code changes needed.

_fields.label: What the push notification calls this rule.
_fields.courses: Course ids from courses.json, or ["any"] for all of them.
_fields.dates: Specific dates ["2026-09-20"], or omit and use daysOfWeek instead.
_fields.withinDays: Only consider slots this many days out (default: the whole polled window).
_fields.minSpots: Minimum open spots (e.g. 4 for a foursome).
_fields.maxGreenFee: Only alert at or under this green fee, in dollars. Omit for any price.
_fields.enabled: false to mute a rule without deleting it.
